decision_conditions:
The London Borough of Camden has consulted the London Borough of Islington on a major planning application at 120–136 Camley Street (Ref: 20254341P) and associated application 3–30 Cedar Way (Ref: 20254364P). The description of development provided is as follows
Demolition of all existing buildings (Class E and B8) and structures and associated works and erection of new buildings comprising a mixed-use redevelopment of residential (Class C3) and commercial (Class E) uses, together with all landscaping, public realm, cycle parking, car parking, highways works and associated works.

It is noted that Camden provisionally considers the application to be a major regeneration proposal within the Camley Street area, delivering significant residential and employment floorspace. The site is adjacent to the LB Islington boundary and forms part of the wider King’s Cross and Camley Street regeneration corridor.

The application site is located approximately 50 metres from the London Borough of Islington boundary and is visible from certain vantage points within Islington. The proposal includes buildings of up to 15 storeys, which would alter the townscape and skyline as viewed from Islington. While the London Borough of Islington raises no objections to the scheme, it notes that Camden Council must determine the application in accordance with the Camden Local Plan (2017) and the Draft New Camden Local Plan (Regulation 19, April 2025).
